Package model.playlist

Class Playlist<T extends Media>

java.lang.Object
model.playlist.Playlist<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of media stored in this playlist, which extends Media.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Storable
public class Playlist<T extends Media> extends Object implements Storable
Represents a playlist that can store one of types of media.It leverages generics to manage different media types and provides functions for adding, removing, viewing, and playing media items.
